basedOn: R31 independent evaluation and frozen 188-feature inventory

changes.change: Active invitations can be reopened, cancelled and expired. A clearly labelled synthetic QR can be exported; it is not a pairing credential.
Native sources expose destination and waiting state. Android description conflicts and pending Central acknowledgements hold affected source files without blocking unrelated local notes.
Local notes have durable drafts, queued content, failure/retry and idempotent delivery. Source checks create deduplicated synthetic pending records. Capture and sending pause independently.
Document processing uses numbered document segments and body lineage; only audio uses time and speaker information.
Library uses three primary tabs. Material kinds and filters are disclosed on demand; the long second navigation rail and repeated all-material headings are removed.
Signed-out native entry permits an explicit allowlist of local tasks, preserves device-owned data across account changes, and keeps Central tasks behind account login.

NAS references, MCP resources, Google Calendar, Gmail, Lark documents/calendar and vendor recordings have separate connection, scope and result steps, retained context, and explicit synthetic receipt states.

File processing rules, profiles, services, saved-rule previews and source overrides are represented with saved/effective distinctions. MCP grants, plugin lifecycle, clarification and work recovery expose their own controls and outcomes.

authorVerification.root: All three platforms completed the import/context nominal regression and connector/material/library focused journeys with zero page errors. Library viewport screenshots were inspected with the fixed CJK font.
authorVerification.native: 54 author checks across Mac, Android and Web negative cases; full details in work/native-r32-handoff.md.
authorVerification.central: 10 focused author journeys including shared policy save and narrow layouts on Mac/Android; no JavaScript runtime errors.
authorVerification.limits: Author checks do not establish independent acceptance. Independent evaluation starts only after this immutable freeze.

boundary: HTML UI simulation using synthetic data. No native runtime, backend, live model, OAuth, actual calendar or device pairing is validated.
